mapper.select: select cohort_id, cohort_name, cohort_year, is_current, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from qt_cohort where cohort_id = #{cohortId}
select cohort_id, cohort_name, cohort_year, is_current, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from qt_cohort where is_current = '1' limit 1
select cohort_id, cohort_name, cohort_year, is_current, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from qt_cohort where cohort_name = #{cohortName} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into qt_cohort (cohort_name, cohort_year, is_current, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{cohortName}, #{cohortYear}, #{isCurrent}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update qt_cohort set is_current = '0' where is_current = '1'
mapper.select: select r.record_id, r.user_id, r.cohort_id, r.role_category, r.member_status, r.join_time, r.retain_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, c.cohort_name from qt_member_record r left join qt_cohort c on r.cohort_id = c.cohort_id where r.user_id = #{userId} and r.cohort_id = #{cohortId} limit 1

select r.record_id, r.user_id, r.cohort_id, r.role_category, r.member_status, r.join_time, r.retain_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, c.cohort_name from qt_member_record r left join qt_cohort c on r.cohort_id = c.cohort_id where r.cohort_id = #{cohortId}
mapper.insert: insert into qt_member_record (user_id, cohort_id, role_category, member_status, join_time, retain_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{cohortId}, #{roleCategory}, #{memberStatus}, #{joinTime}, #{retainFlag}, #{createBy}, now())
